# Combined Cycle Gas Turbine (CombinedCycle_CCGT)

> **Class**: `CombinedCycle_CCGT` | **Module**: `energysim.models.thermal` | [Validation benchmarks](../validation.md) | [Units](../units.md)

## Overview

Combined Cycle Gas Turbine (CCGT), plant-level surrogate.

The plant is a single dispatchable block: electrical output follows the
setpoint subject to a ramp limit, an ambient-temperature capacity derate
curve (``T_amb`` input) and minimum stable generation. Output is split into
a *fixed* gas-turbine / steam-turbine share (``gt_ratio``); fuel use follows
a part-load heat-rate curve; CO2 follows from fuel. There is no HRSG,
Rankine cycle or steam-side dynamics. Minimum up/down time are enforced
through the shared operating state machine (defaults 0 = disabled, i.e.
ramp-only behaviour); there is no cold/warm/hot start sequence.

Validity: T_amb -20..45 C, loads between MSG and rated.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | `str` | `'CCGT'` | - | - |
| `p_rated_mw` | `float` | `400.0` | MW | Total combined cycle plant rated capacity (GT + ST) in MW. |
| `gt_ratio` | `float` | `0.67` | - | Fraction of total capacity delivered by the gas turbine (typically 2/3). |
| `heat_rate_full_load_kj_kwh` | `float` | `6400.0` | kJ/kWh | Full load CCGT plant heat rate (kJ/kWh LHV, ~56.2% efficiency). |
| `min_stable_gen_pct` | `float` | `40.0` | % | Minimum stable generation limit (% of total plant capacity). |
| `ramp_rate_mw_min` | `float` | `15.0` | MW/min | Maximum CCGT ramp rate in MW/min. |
| `step_size` | `float` | `1.0` | s | - |
| `min_uptime_sec` | `float` | `0.0` | s | Minimum running / offline time (0 disables). |
| `min_downtime_sec` | `float` | `0.0` | s | Minimum running / offline time (0 disables). |
| `ambient_derate_curve` | `Optional[Curve1D]` | `None` | - | Capacity multiplier vs ambient temperature in degC. |

## Inputs

| Variable | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `P_cmd` | MW | Active power generation dispatch order |
| `T_amb` | degC | Ambient compressor inlet air temperature |

## Outputs

| Variable | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `P_actual` | MW | Total combined active power delivered to the transmission bus |
| `P_gt` | MW | Gas turbine electrical power output |
| `P_st` | MW | Steam turbine electrical power output |
| `fuel_consumption_MMBtu_hr` | MMBtu/h | Natural gas fuel firing rate |
| `CO2_emissions_t_hr` | t/h | Instantaneous carbon dioxide emission rate |
| `Q_condenser_MW` | MW | Cooling tower / condenser heat rejection load |
| `state` | - | - |

## Usage example

```python
from energysim import world
from energysim.models import CombinedCycle_CCGT

sim = world(start_time=0, stop_time=3600, t_macro=900)
sim.add_model('combinedcycle_ccgt', model=CombinedCycle_CCGT(), outputs=['P_actual', 'P_gt', 'P_st'], step_size=60)
res = sim.simulate()
print(res['combinedcycle_ccgt'].tail(2))
```
